description: Implementation of HostResolverNat64Task class for DNS resolution and IPv6 synthesis in the net namespace.

classes.name: HostResolverNat64Task
classes.description: Handles DNS resolution and IPv6 address synthesis for NAT64.

methods.name: HostResolverNat64Task
methods.description: Constructor initializing the NAT64 resolution task with hostname, network key, log, context, cache, and resolver.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the resolution process, posting completion task if not pending.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop handling different resolution states.

methods.name: DoResolve
methods.description: Performs DNS request for IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: DoResolveComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of DNS request, fallback to IPv4 if needed.

methods.name: DoSynthesizeToIpv6
methods.description: Synthesizes IPv6 addresses from IPv4 addresses using DNS64.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Callback for I/O completion, continues loop.
